description_en: Queries the details of an ETL task
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-dts-etl-job-version-info --dts-instance-id dtsggk12iwya1a0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDtsEtlJobVersionInfo

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Settings this parameter for paging. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number of the instance status list. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前实例状态列表的页码，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The DTS instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html接口查询实例ID
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ETL task ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh: ETL任务ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html接口查询任务ID
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DTS instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html operation to query available regions
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html接口查询阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

DtsEtlJobVersionInfos.description_en: The array of ETL task information objects
DtsEtlJobVersionInfos.description_zh: 返回ETL任务信息对象数组

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the ETL task was created

DtsJobName.description_en: The name of the ETL task

SafeCheckpoint.description_en: The safe checkpoint, which indicates the current position of the ETL task
SafeCheckpoint.description_zh: 安全检查点，即ETL任务的当前位点

Status.description_en: The log level. Valid values: ERROR, WARN, INFO, and DEBUG

Version.description_en: The version number of the ETL task

DynamicCode.description_en: The dynamic error code associated with this request
DynamicCode.description_zh: 与本次请求相关的动态错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en: The dynamic error message associated with this request
DynamicMessage.description_zh: 与本次请求相关的动态错误信息
DynamicMessage.example: present environment is not support,so skip

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned when the specified ETL task ID is invalid and the corresponding task cannot be found
ErrCode.description_zh: 传入的ETL任务ID错误，找不到对应的任务

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the specified ETL task ID is invalid and the corresponding task cannot be found. The task may have been deleted
ErrMessage.description_zh: 传入的ETL任务ID错误，找不到对应的任务（任务可能已删除）
ErrMessage.example: The specified dts job id %s is not exists.

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the instance status list. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前实例状态列表的页码，默认为1

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of records on the current page

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. A value of false indicates a failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，如果失败则返回false
